# countdown-api: the contract between this broker and the renderer, and the code generated from it (the Pydantic
# models and the Flask views; the [server] extra adds Flask). It isn't on PyPI; its latest page is a package index,
# and the page's constraints.txt pins the version, so the latest release is installed whatever it is. See README,
# "The device API contract".
--extra-index-url https://nvorkinn.github.io/countdown-api/simple/
-c https://nvorkinn.github.io/countdown-api/constraints.txt
countdown-api[server]
